title: Build a schema-aware atomic Termina snapshot updater
description: Replace manual refresh steps with a safe updater that downloads to temporary paths, validates the manifest and schema, checks SQLite integrity and hashes, and emits a semantic delta before promotion.
acceptance_criteria: The updater never overwrites the pinned snapshot before all checks pass; reports table, incident, campaign, venue, claim, evidence, and record deltas; rejects unsupported schema changes; supports dry-run; and has offline fixture tests for unchanged, changed, corrupt, and incompatible inputs.
close_reason: Implemented staged schema-v9 updater with pre-promotion manifest/schema/table/integrity/hash validation, semantic deltas for all tables and six core entities, dry-run, atomic per-file promotion, operator docs, and offline unchanged/changed/corrupt/incompatible tests.

title: Reproduce the retrieval-venue no-coordination classification
description: Audit the reported 870-body retrieval classification behind retrieval-venues-never-talk, distinguishing observed absence of coordination language from unavailable or uncollected bodies.
acceptance_criteria: The report accounts for the full claimed denominator; provides reproducible inclusion, exclusion, and classification rules; publishes representative false-positive/false-negative review results without redistributing sensitive bodies; and assigns an evidence status consistent with what was actually available.
close_reason: Added a reproducible metadata audit and report for the retrieval-venue no-coordination claim. The audit checks all 3,948 pinned probier/fractal records, preserves exact database identity, accounts for the published 870 denominator as 622 stated data-cache/bridge cells plus an implied 248 probe-test remainder, and records the 104 ambiguous-minute and 192 unattached-entry exclusions. It finds only one of four published category cells matches the current snapshot (164/166 probier data-cache, 235/235 probier bridge, 187/191 fractal data-cache, 34/30 fractal bridge), no stored 870-row selector, 767 absent referenced bodies, and no recoverable original classifier. It therefore assigns reported-not-independently-reproduced status, publishes metadata-only samples and a zero-review FP/FN result without redistributing bodies, and defines an authored protocol for a future independent review. Added 5 focused tests; all 179 repository script tests pass, py_compile and git diff --check pass.

title: Reproduce the Termina cross-network /16 mixture result
description: Recompute the networks-do-not-separate-populations claim from the pinned database and referenced source rows, separating shared hosting/network infrastructure from evidence of a shared actor population.
acceptance_criteria: A script and report publish exact input populations, normalization rules, /16 overlap counts, sensitivity checks, and a bounded conclusion; missing source material is reported as a limitation rather than silently inferred; tests exercise network normalization.
close_reason: Reproduced all 189 population-labeled /16 categories and the 543-row rmn.re join; added normalization and threshold-sensitivity tests, corrected 131 balanced vs 137 actually shared prefixes, accounted for 48 unmatched plus 1 redacted rmn.re row, and retained inferred/same-lineage status.

title: Audit Termina evidence lineage and circular corroboration
description: Build an evidence-to-claim lineage audit for all pinned Termina claims. Identify same-publisher checks, secondary-on-secondary support, missing local artifacts, and evidence reused across claims.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic script and dated JSON/Markdown report cover all 237 claims and 67 evidence rows; each support edge is classified by source tier and independence; circular or non-independent corroboration is explicitly flagged; tests cover classification and missing references.
close_reason: Implemented deterministic full-database evidence-lineage audit with 237 claims, 67 evidence rows, 273 classified edges, path availability, circular/same-publisher and non-primary-on-non-primary flags; added Markdown/JSON outputs, README entry, and 5 passing focused tests.

title: Resolve Termina deltas and harden ongoing ingestion
description: Close the highest-value evidence gaps exposed by the third-source integration and make future Termina updates reproducible, bounded, and graph-safe.
acceptance_criteria: Each child has a reproducible artifact or tested implementation; conclusions preserve reported/inferred/verified distinctions; the epic closes only after all blocking children are resolved.

title: Cross-check Termina claims against the archive
description: Reconcile all Termina claims relevant to the DSEWiki incident against this repository, the collusion.wiki-derived export evidence, and Joshua David's reconstruction. Classify claims as corroborated, conflicting, new, or repeated without promoting inferred/reported rows.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible machine-readable delta and analysis/termina-crosscheck.md cover every relevant claim, preserve evidence/status provenance, and identify actionable corrections or additions.
close_reason: Completed row-level audit of all 80 DSE-relevant claims with resolved evidence: 13 independently corroborated, 37 new (mostly daily scan snapshots), 29 repeated/shared-lineage, 1 conflicting. Added reproducible generator, machine-readable report, narrative, and tests.

title: Pin and verify the Termina schema-v9 snapshot
description: Store the complete CC0 SQLite snapshot with manifest, schema, checksums, documentation, and a reproducible integrity verifier.
acceptance_criteria: SQLite integrity passes; every manifest table count matches; checked-in JSONL and snapshot hashes verify; source and licence boundaries are documented.
close_reason: Pinned schema-v9 SQLite, manifest, schema and checksums; verifier and 107 repository tests pass.

title: Operationalize the Termina incident database
description: Use the pinned swarm.termina.digital schema-v9 database as a provenance-aware third structured source for this archive. Work includes reproducible ingestion, cross-source claim auditing, graph enrichment, comparative incident analysis, and status-aware timeline/detector studies.
acceptance_criteria: The snapshot is verified; Termina claims are reconciled against existing sources; downstream graph and comparative analyses preserve evidence and status semantics.
close_reason: All five child beads complete: verified snapshot, 80-claim cross-check, full Atlas provenance layer, six-incident matrix, and eight-campaign timeline/detector analysis.

title: Turn Termina scanner snapshots into a status-aware change feed
description: Generate reviewable changes from successive Termina snapshots, alerting on meaningful verdict or coverage transitions while preserving the distinction between scanner inference and verified evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic command compares two validated snapshots; emits additions, removals, verdict transitions, coverage changes, and evidence-status changes; suppresses unchanged daily observations; never promotes inferred scan output to verified; and includes fixture tests plus operator documentation.
close_reason: Implemented validated snapshot-to-snapshot change feed for claim additions/removals, status and evidence-lineage changes, evidence changes, scanner coverage/row/verdict transitions, unchanged-daily suppression, inferred-only scanner enforcement, operator docs, and 5 fixture tests.

title: Reproduce the Vanderbilt 121-click delta from archived evidence
description: Validate the reported post-publication Vanderbilt shortlink click increase using archived manifests/captures only, without triggering redirects or mutating live counters.
acceptance_criteria: The report identifies pre/post observations, timestamps, counter semantics, and arithmetic; confirms no live redirect was followed during reproduction; labels alternative explanations and evidence strength; missing captures produce a bounded non-verification.
close_reason: Added offline-only Vanderbilt click audit: parsed 8-link/121-click and 114+7 arithmetic, recorded Sep 4/Sep 6 observation bounds and YOURLS counter semantics, verified local artifact presence/hashes without fetching URLs, documented alternative callers, and correctly returned bounded non-verification because both captures are absent.

title: Verify the KMAD 6,271-install wiki sweep
description: Reproduce or bound the kmad-wiki-sweep claim from its referenced repository/artifacts, enumerating target generation, response coverage, retry policy, and limits of the negative result.
acceptance_criteria: A report accounts for the 6,271 target denominator or documents the exact unavailable inputs; distinguishes unreachable, non-wiki, scanned, and candidate hosts; records time sensitivity; and states what no-new-host can and cannot establish.
close_reason: Audited immutable KMAD commit 2ee3df2: the 6,271-candidate statement appears only in three narrative files across 190 tracked files, with no targets, response ledger, sweep implementation, timestamps, retry policy, positive-control log, or machine result. Documented one reported texteditors.org match, incomplete Oddmuse follow-up, and bounded the null as reported/non-reproducible.

title: Add operational and provenance views to the Atlas
description: Keep Termina incident/campaign/task-cluster provenance available without allowing those high-degree summary nodes to distort operational shortest paths, community detection, or default visual interpretation.
acceptance_criteria: The Atlas can switch between operational and provenance views; clustering and path analysis exclude provenance-only edges by default; counts and legend disclose the active view; existing Termina links remain inspectable; idempotence and view-filter tests pass.

title: Audit distinct-write estimates against Termina semantics
description: Validate the campaign timeline's distinct-write estimator against Termina schema/glossary semantics and quantify defensible lower/central/upper bounds by campaign and venue.
acceptance_criteria: A dated methodology note explains save/revision/rc-row and paste/shortlink handling; alternate dedupe rules produce bounded estimates; large divergences are enumerated; the generated campaign analysis exposes uncertainty instead of a single unexplained count; tests lock the rules.
close_reason: Grounded estimator in the published Termina glossary; added lower/central/upper campaign and venue bounds, retained central compatibility, enumerated material overlap spreads, documented methodology, and added ordering/usemod regression tests.

title: Build a comparative incident matrix
description: Compare DSEWiki with the Artifactory, Hugging Face, Modal, AISI, and UseMod research-environment incidents across dates, severity, categories, controls, attribution, and evidence quality.
acceptance_criteria: A generated table and narrative distinguish common mechanisms from unsupported population links and cite the underlying claim/evidence rows.
close_reason: Generated a six-incident comparison from the pinned Termina schema-v9 database, covering dates, severity, categories, attribution, defenses, and evidence quality. Added row-level claim/evidence provenance, explicit population-link caveats, machine-readable output, and five offline regression tests; full suite passes (118 tests).

title: Extend the Backchannel Atlas from the full Termina graph
description: Import useful campaign, cluster, claim/evidence, and edge relationships from the full Termina database instead of limiting the Atlas integration to venue_link.jsonl.
acceptance_criteria: The Atlas exposes newly justified relationships with explicit Termina source/status metadata, remains idempotently rebuildable, and passes graph tests.
close_reason: Atlas now imports the DSE incident, two campaigns, seven task clusters, and 47 cluster-to-venue aggregates from incidents.sqlite. Node details retain claim-status/evidence counts; 16,073 raw record edges are summarized. Rebuild is idempotent and tests pass.

title: Evaluate timelines and detectors across Termina campaigns
description: Use status-aware Termina records to compare activity timelines and detector signals across swarms, single-operator runs, research environments, visitors, and human controls.
acceptance_criteria: The analysis counts distinct writes separately from observations, reports provenance/coverage limitations, and includes reproducible code and tests.
close_reason: Generated all-campaign timeline/detector analysis with revision-first write estimates, observation/write ratios, dated peaks, latest inferred scan coverage, human-baseline controls, machine-readable output, and four regression tests.
